title: A guard mixing unsigned and signed comparisons readmits the overdraft
violates: The sender's balance stays at zero or above, read as a signed number: `A − X ≥ 0`.
because: The guard compares the bits as unsigned numbers and the property compares the same bits as signed ones, and the sender's balance has its top bit set.
class: a guard and a property that read the same bits with different signs

cured_by.text: Pick one reading of the bits and use it in every comparison.
